title: net.osc.send
description: `net.osc.send` sends OSC messages to a destination server, supporting automatically typed values as well as explicitly typed values such as booleans, floats, integers, strings, blobs, MIDI, null, and infinity. Set the destination with a server URL such as `osc.udp://localhost:9000`; each send message includes an OSC path followed by any required values.
